title: Applied Climate Information System station data
product_or_endpoint: StnData JSON for KTDZ / Toledo Executive Airport
use_limitations: Daily values are station observations; missing and trace precipitation are retained as limitations.

title: NOAA NCEI Climate at a Glance
product_or_endpoint: County temperature time series
use_limitations: Climate variability context; recent values may be preliminary and are not a station extreme.

title: National Weather Service API point metadata
product_or_endpoint: Toledo-area point forecast / warning service linkage
use_limitations: Service endpoint identifies forecast and warning systems; it is not an observed hazard surface.

title: NWS Weather Research and Forecasting Climate portal
product_or_endpoint: NOWData and local climate products
use_limitations: Portal documents station and product context; interactive output is not embedded as a new regional climatology.

title: USGS National Water Information System daily values
product_or_endpoint: Daily mean discharge, Maumee River at Waterville OH
use_limitations: One gauge is not the whole watershed; daily flow is not a floodplain footprint or future trend.

title: FEMA National Flood Hazard Layer
product_or_endpoint: Regulatory flood-hazard mapping context
use_limitations: Regulatory zones are modeled mapping products and are distinct from observed or forecast floods.

title: NOAA/NWS Precipitation Frequency Data Server
product_or_endpoint: Atlas 14 precipitation-frequency context
use_limitations: Frequency estimates are not substituted for an observed event and are not a future climate projection.

title: U.S. Drought Monitor county area statistics
product_or_endpoint: Percent of Lucas County area by weekly drought category
use_limitations: Weekly expert assessment integrates multiple indicators; not a soil-moisture measurement at every location.

title: U.S. Drought Monitor DSCI service
product_or_endpoint: Lucas County Drought Severity and Coverage Index
use_limitations: DSCI is a drought-status index and is not a physical flow or groundwater-depletion estimate.

title: Drought.gov U.S. Drought Monitor description
product_or_endpoint: Product definitions and category meaning
use_limitations: Supports category interpretation and limitations, not a new local measurement.

title: NOAA CO-OPS Toledo daily mean water levels
product_or_endpoint: Daily mean water level at station 9063085
use_limitations: Daily means describe lake level at one gauge; wind setup/seiche is not represented by the daily mean alone.

title: NOAA CO-OPS station metadata
product_or_endpoint: Toledo station metadata
use_limitations: Provides station identity and Great Lakes designation; not an event series.

title: NOAA CO-OPS station datum metadata
product_or_endpoint: Great Lakes Lower Water Datum and extrema metadata
use_limitations: Datum and historical extrema context must not be mixed with flood thresholds without their stated units and references.

title: NOAA CO-OPS/NWS station flood levels
product_or_endpoint: Toledo action and NWS minor/moderate/major thresholds
use_limitations: Thresholds are warning-stage references, not observed water levels or damage estimates.

title: NOAA Great Lakes Environmental Research Laboratory water levels
product_or_endpoint: Great Lakes monitoring, observations, forecasts, and ice resources
use_limitations: Provides network and process context; it does not make a local hazard probability claim.

title: NOAA NCEI Storm Events details archive
product_or_endpoint: 2025 Storm Events details snapshot
use_limitations: Counts are selected county event records, not rates, probabilities, attribution, or hazard zones.

title: NOAA NCEI Storm Events archive directory
product_or_endpoint: Archive inventory and version context
use_limitations: Used to identify the dated 2025 details snapshot; the full bulk archive is not committed.

title: NOAA NCEI Storm Events Database
product_or_endpoint: Storm Events documentation and access
use_limitations: Historical event reports do not define deterministic future risk zones.

title: NWS winter safety and hazard information
product_or_endpoint: Winter storm, snow, ice, and cold hazard context
use_limitations: General hazard definitions and preparedness context; not a local climatology.

title: NWS thunderstorm safety and hazard information
product_or_endpoint: Thunderstorm, damaging wind, hail, and lightning context
use_limitations: Supports physical hazard definitions; no local event rate is inferred from guidance.

title: NOAA Storm Prediction Center climatology and online resources
product_or_endpoint: Severe convective weather climatology context
use_limitations: Regional context does not turn historical event points into deterministic future risk zones.
